lines.en: I drift in midair, shifting slowly.
My tentacles hang like tattered cloth.
My body swells and contracts as I float.
I pass above the lava lakes.
The air dries as I pass.
I do not land. I never land.
My huge shadow slides across the ground.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛一路看着下面
lines.en: My eyes stay on the ground below.

lines.zh: 光从我的身体里透出来
lines.en: Light shows through my body.
The air is pushed aside by me.
My frame shifts beneath the skin.
I rotate slowly as I advance.
I drift over a stretch of blackstone.
My cry is low and muffled.

lines.zh: 身上的裂口露出一片亮
lines.en: A tear in me shows a bright patch.
I drift faster than a person walks.
I stop in midair and look around.

lines.zh: 火球的火光在我身上晃
lines.en: Fireball light flickers on my body.
Only wind is left in the quiet.
My tentacles sway slowly.
I am waiting for someone to pass below.
Something burns inside my body.
I turn my eyes slowly.
I have been here a long while.
I let out a long cry.

lines.zh: 下面的石头裂开了一条缝
lines.en: A crack opens in the stone below.
I hover without moving.
Some fragments fall from me.
I turn my head to look at you.
You are standing too far forward.
You smell of the living.
I open my mouth slowly.
You did not hide. Good.
I never need to look down.
You may try to run.

lines.zh: 这里没有可以挡的东西
lines.en: There is nothing here to hide behind.
My shadow reaches you first.
A tear opens in my hide.
I sway, then steady.
The firelight grows brighter.
Such a wound is nothing to me.
I rise off a little.
My tentacles draw back.
I give one low cry.
Light leaks from my body.
That one had some weight.
You are stronger than I thought.
That is far too little.
You stand there holding it up.
I need none of that.
Try throwing it up here.
I want something else.
You smell of fire.
Back off, and I will look.
That does not suit my appetite.
I will not stop for you.

lines.zh: 我被撞了一下，纹丝不动
lines.en: A blow, and I do not shift.
What you struck is my hide.
I pass over the top of you.
That pushed you a long way back.
I have no reason to stop.
One of my tentacles brushes you.
You are pushed against the stone wall.
I barely noticed.
The air is displaced; you stumble.
There is a great gap between us.
I am alone in this region.
The lava is my companion.
I forgot such things long ago.
I can only spit fire.
I have drifted here too long.

lines.zh: 我的身体不属于我自己
lines.en: This body is not my own.
Do not ask such things.
It is too hot below for that.
I keep drifting.
Let it drop.
My tentacle coils around it.
I cannot grasp anything so small.
It burns away against my body.
I look, then drop it.
This is not what I seek.
It sticks to my hide.
I fling it away.
That is not enough weight.
I have no need of it at all.
It fell away in midair.
I have seen you from above.
This position is good for firing.
You will not leave this clearing.
There is light when I open my mouth.
The fireball is already in my throat.
I do not need to aim long.
There is no roof below.
I have your position.
I fire when you look up.
I have dropped a little lower.
I have stayed above you.
I see wherever you run.
The fireball lights me up.
I drop a little lower.
I am counting your steps.
This ground is very flat.
You have hidden behind a pillar.
A pillar will not stop fire.
I move along after you slowly.
My shadow stays over you.
The fireball leaves my mouth.
The fireball lands with a dull roar.
That tore the ground open.
You dodged again.
The flames chase after you.
I close my mouth after firing.
That shot went a little wide.
The stone is baked red.
I turn slowly back.
You are on fire.
I rise up out of the lava.
Fireball light hits the wall first.

lines.zh: 我漂到这一片空地上方
lines.en: I drift above this clearing.
The air turns hot at once.
My tentacles droop slowly.
The stone below is still smoking.
First I gave one deep cry.
I came from somewhere far off.

lines.zh: 我的影子盖住了一大片
lines.en: My shadow covers a great expanse.

lines.zh: 这里没有别的东西活着
lines.en: Nothing else lives here.
Fire is of no use against me.
I drop straight down from height.
The steam shrinks my body.
The blast pushes me back a stretch.
Something pierces my hide.

lines.zh: 那力量在我体内转了一圈
lines.en: That force turns once inside me.
Hungry, my fireballs shrink.
Lightning strikes and my whole body flares.

lines.zh: 这里没有热，也没有石头
lines.en: No heat here, and no stone.
